method: each scenario runs one path through at least three components with one planted defect, beside a positive control on the same path; fixtures, temp folders, fixed clocks, sockets refused

old_code_check.command: the 5ebce8a test file run against 0d66379 in a detached worktree

scenarios.path: vendor candle reader -> integration eligibility -> abstention -> state -> reports
scenarios.planted_defect: candles closing at or after the decision minus the lag
scenarios.control: served reference candle gives the fixture forecast and the report shows it

scenarios.path: export decision rows -> integration identity -> pool -> reader -> request record
scenarios.planted_defect: a token row of another mint (and, after the repair, of another chain)
scenarios.control: the decision's own token row gives the fixture forecast
scenarios.at_0d66379: not observed: the other mint's pool was read and recorded
scenarios.at_5ebce8a: NOT_EXACT_IDENTITY, TOKEN_ROW_OF_ANOTHER_IDENTITY, no read, no document

scenarios.path: scout or analyze hook -> run_pass -> store time units -> state
scenarios.planted_defect: capture time and observed time in milliseconds
scenarios.control: the observed-time case is an ERROR event with no document
scenarios.at_0d66379: hooks contained it as a failure; run_pass raised
scenarios.at_5ebce8a: CAPTURE_TIME_REFUSED returned and shown, nothing written

scenarios.planted_defect: a body whose base token is another mint; a URL whose token parameter is not exactly the mint
scenarios.control: an identity-checked LABELED outcome appends and verifies
scenarios.at_0d66379: labels refuse the body; the ledger's own rule is a substring test

scenarios.path: calibration card -> registry -> integration -> abstention -> reports
scenarios.planted_defect: a calibration card whose evidence is the spent retrospective holdout, re-hashed or not

scenarios.path: baselines fit -> card -> registry pin and serve -> abstention -> integration -> reports
scenarios.planted_defect: a card whose training labels mature five days after its cutoff
scenarios.control: the replay guard check_card_time refuses the card
scenarios.at_0d66379: not observed: the card was pinned, served and published a FORECAST
scenarios.at_5ebce8a: pin refused (TRAINING_ROWS_AFTER_CUTOFF); a hand-written pin is blocked by serve, no number

scenarios.path: state request record and document -> reports reader
scenarios.planted_defect: a point moved inside its interval in the document and the request record, resealed; a stored raw number or input moved
scenarios.control: a point moved outside the Wilson band is refused
scenarios.at_0d66379: not observed: the forged point was shown
